## Current Offers

:::: {.entry .active}
#### Development of nonparametric methods for the evaluation of surrogate markers in the non-continuous data setting


**Description:** 4-6 month internship for a Master student. This project concerns the extension of non-parametric, rank-based approaches for surrogate marker evaluation, in the case where either the surrogate candidate, or the clinical endpoint (or both) are not of a continuous data type (for example, binary, ordinal, or time-to-event data).

## Past Offers

### 2025

:::: {.entry}
#### Evaluation of Approaches for Identifying High-Dimensional Individual-Level Surrogate Markers Applied to Vaccinology

**Description:** Proposal for a 6-month internship for a master's student, co-supervised by Boris Hejblum and me. The subject of the internship is the comparison of methods for identifying individual-level surrogate markers of the vaccine response. The project was completed by master's student Roaya Jannatipour.

[View internship offer](internships/Internship_proposal_25_26_ILS.pdf){.pill target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}
::::

:::: {.entry}
#### Evaluation of Gene Expression as Trial-Level Surrogate Markers of Vaccination Across Multiple Settings

**Description:** Proposal for a 6-month internship for a master's student, co-supervised by Boris Hejblum and me. The subject of the internship is the evaluation of trial-level surrogate markers of the vaccine response using our recently developed approach, which relies on meta-analysis tools to evaluate the generalisability of signatures across multiple clinical trials.

[View internship offer](internships/Internship_proposal_25_26_TLS.pdf){.pill target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}
::::

### 2024

:::: {.entry}
#### Evaluating High-Dimensional Surrogate Markers of the Yellow Fever Vaccine Response

**Description:** Proposal for a 6-month internship for a master's student, co-supervised by Boris Hejblum and me. The subject of the internship was the identification and evaluation of high-dimensional trial-level surrogate markers of the vaccine response to yellow fever vaccination. The project was completed by master's student Theodora Georgakopoulou.

[View internship offer](internships/Internship_offer_24_25.pdf){.pill target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}
